title: Book Three · Chapter 162: The Box at the Tool Shop
story:
On Saturday, the day before Ronan's birthday, he meets Dad outside the workshop at lunch time.

Dad wants to buy a folding rule on the way home. His old one is difficult to read near one joint.

The tool shop is open. There are boxes beside the wall and narrow shelves behind the counter.

The seller takes out two rules. Dad opens one across the clear part of the counter.

Ronan watches the short pieces become one long measure. Dad checks the joints, then the marks at the end. The marks are dark on both sides. Dad turns it over and reads the other end.

“This one,” he says.

It costs two yuan. Dad pays from his own tool money. Ronan's study money stays at home.

While the seller wraps the rule, Ronan sees a city name on one of the boxes. It is the coastal city from the centre's address.

“Did this box come from there?” he asks.

The seller looks at it.

“From a warehouse there. The tools come from several places.”

He turns the box so Dad can see the label too.

Ronan reads the name once more. Until now, he has mostly seen it on letters and course pages.

“You know the city?” the seller asks.

“I am asking about a training programme there.”

“Woodwork?”

“Business and office work. Customer messages. Numbers too.”

The seller smiles and points to the papers beneath his counter.

“Plenty of those here.”

Dad takes the wrapped rule. The seller moves another box toward the shelf and says goodbye.

Outside, Dad carries the narrow parcel beside his leg.

“More than the sea picture,” he says.

“Yes.”

Ronan looks back at the shop door. A woman is going in with a small order sheet. The seller comes forward to listen.

On the road home, Ronan asks Dad about the different tool suppliers. Dad explains how he checks a new tool before he uses it for a customer's piece.

They stop at the crowded corner and let two carts pass. Then they cross together.

At home, Mum has lunch ready. Dad puts the rule with his work bag before he sits down.

Ronan takes the bowls from the shelf. Mum looks up at him.

“Last lunch at seventeen.”

“I still need dinner.”

Dad laughs and moves his plate closer. Mum puts another spoonful of vegetables into Ronan's bowl, and he sits beside them while Dad describes the new rule's clear marks.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

folding rule＝折尺；joint＝连接处、关节；warehouse＝仓库；supplier＝供货方。

## 理解问题

1. 折尺是谁买、用哪部分钱付？有没有减少Ronan的学习存款？
2. 工具箱上的城市名让Ronan看见了怎样实际的城市联系？本章他已经十八岁了吗？

## 读句子

**Dad pays from his own tool money.**

拆开看：Dad / pays / from his own tool money.

Dad／付款／用他自己留作工具开销的钱。
